title: Democratizing LLM Training with the Edge: Challenges, Systems, and the Road Ahead
abstract: arXiv:2610.32215v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing computational power of modern GPU data centers has let a few industrial giants train and deploy large language models (LLMs) on massive amounts of data. Yet the sheer scale of these models and their training data makes centralized development increasingly hard to sustain, and at the same time shuts out smaller institutions that hold relevant private data but lack comparable infrastructure. In this paper, we organize our positions on distributed LLM training around the pretraining and fine-tuning paradigms, covering federated learning, split learning, and decentralized approaches, and we assess their readiness for geo-distributed settings with heterogeneous hardware and unreliable connectivity. We then present a {\em unified} system architecture built around a cloud-hosted parameter server that coordinates heterogeneous clients over outbound gRPC connections, reusing one communication, compression, and fault-tolerance stack

translated_title: 利用边缘算力实现大语言模型训练的民主化：挑战、系统与未来之路
translated_abstract: 现代GPU数据中心日益增长的计算能力使得少数工业巨头能够在海量数据上训练和部署大语言模型（LLM）。然而，这些模型及其训练数据的庞大规模使得集中式开发方式越来越难以持续，同时也将那些拥有相关私有数据但缺乏同等基础设施的小型机构拒之门外。在本文中，我们围绕预训练和微调两种范式，系统阐述了关于分布式LLM训练的立场观点，涵盖联邦学习、拆分学习和去中心化方法，并评估了它们在具有异构硬件和不可靠网络连接的地理分布式环境中的适用程度。随后，我们提出了一个以云端托管参数服务器为核心的统一系统架构，该服务器通过出站gRPC连接协调异构客户端，并复用统一的通信、压缩和容错技术栈。
tldr: 本文提出以云端参数服务器为核心的统一分布式训练系统架构，系统评估了联邦学习、拆分学习和去中心化方法在异构硬件与不可靠网络环境下的可行性，旨在让缺乏大型数据中心基础设施的中小机构也能利用自身私有数据参与大语言模型的训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified system architecture built around a cloud-hosted parameter server for distributed LLM training, systematically assessing the readiness of federated, split, and decentralized learning approaches in geo-distributed settings with heterogeneous hardware and unreliable connectivity, thereby enabling smaller institutions with private data but limited infrastructure to participate in LLM training.
